title: Anchoring and Rescaling Attention for Semantically Coherent Inbetweening
abstract: arXiv:2603.17651v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative inbetweening (GI) seeks to synthesize realistic intermediate frames between the first and last keyframes beyond mere interpolation. As sequences become sparser and motions larger, previous GI models struggle with inconsistent frames with unstable pacing and semantic misalignment. Since GI involves fixed endpoints and numerous plausible paths, this task requires additional guidance gained from the keyframes and text to specify the intended path. Thus, we give semantic and temporal guidance from the keyframes and text onto each intermediate frame through Keyframe-anchored Attention Bias. We also better enforce frame consistency with Rescaled Temporal RoPE, which allows self-attention to attend to keyframes more faithfully. translated_title: 锚定与重缩放注意力以实现语义连贯的中间帧生成
translated_abstract: 生成式中间帧插值（GI）旨在超越简单的插值，在首尾关键帧之间合成逼真的中间帧。随着序列变得愈发稀疏、动作幅度增大，以往的 GI 模型难以保持帧间一致性，会出现节奏不稳定和语义错位的问题。由于 GI 涉及固定的端点和众多可能的路径，该任务需要从关键帧和文本中获取额外的引导来指定预期的路径。因此，我们通过关键帧锚定注意力偏置，将来自关键帧和文本的语义与时间引导施加到每个中间帧上。我们还通过重缩放的时间 RoPE 更好地强化帧一致性，使自注意力能够更忠实地关注关键帧。TGI-Bench 是首个专为文本条件 GI 评估设计的基准，能够进行针对特定挑战的评估来分析 GI 模型。在无需额外训练的情况下，我们的方法取得了……
tldr: 该方法通过关键帧锚定注意力偏置与重缩放时间 RoPE 为中间帧提供语义和时间引导，无需额外训练即可生成语义连贯、节奏稳定的中间帧，并提出了首个文本条件 GI 评估基准 TGI-Bench。
en_tdlr: Without additional training, this work achieves semantically coherent and temporally stable text-conditioned generative inbetweening via Keyframe-anchored Attention Bias and Rescaled Temporal RoPE, and introduces TGI-Bench, the first benchmark for text-conditioned GI evaluation.
